output.title: New opt-in annotation-copy flag does not affect this environment
output.content: The change adds a new controller option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies listed annotation keys from an Ingress or Gateway to the resulting Certificate. The excerpt describes it only as an added option, so nothing in it says behaviour changes unless the operator sets it. The environment's values keys (for example `replicaCount`, `webhook.timeoutSeconds`) do not include any controller extraArgs setting for this flag. The manifests show `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` but no Ingress or Gateway apiVersions, so the ingress-shim path is not shown in use. The values dimension is only partial, so this is a note and not a proof.
